title: Brightness of Starlink V2 Mini satellites in on-station brightness-mitigation mode

citation.authors: A. Mallama, R.E. Cole, S. Harrington, P.D. Maley
citation.title: Starlink Generation 2 Mini Satellites: Photometric Characterization

satellite.name: Starlink V2 Mini (mitigated)
satellite.notes: On-station V2 Minis in SpaceX's brightness-mitigation conops: arrays edge-on to the Earth's limb (section 5, SpaceX private communication), second-generation dielectric mirror film on the nadir face. Early-mission (unmitigated) observations are a separate population the model does not fly.

magnitudes.band: visual and video (close to Johnson V; section 3, Figure 2)
magnitudes.atmosphere: above (differential against nearby catalogue stars, which cancels extinction; section 3)

n.locator: DERIVED: (StDev / SD_Mean)^2 = (0.79 / 0.09)^2 from Table 2; the paper does not print the mitigated count

shell.locator: section 2: on-station satellites at 480 km (some later 520 km); inclination not stated (Starlink Group 6 shells are 43 deg)

period.locator: section 1 (observations through 2023 June 3); section 2 (launch 6-1 on 2023 February 27). Mitigated satellites were observed mostly from mid-May.

sites.name: R. Cole
sites.locator: Table 1; count: 397 visual magnitudes split evenly (per-observer counts unpublished)

constraints.note: Selection limits are not stated. Site weights: the per-observer split of the MITIGATED observations is unpublished; the counts above split all observations. Observations beyond 1000 km are included (section 5).

censoring.locator: section 5: 18 of 506 attempts not seen; 0.5 added to the limiting magnitude (generally about 8). The count covers both populations.

transcription.check: summary only: the paper does not publish individual observations
